1. **Sun’s position at sunrise**  
   At a sunrise so the sun just rises from the eastern horizon.

   The person himself is facing the pole, so his “right side” is the side that is **west** of the pole.  
   (If you were standing north‑south, his right would be west, but regardless, the position depends on the sun orientation.)

   If the sun is east, the shadow is west.
